lines.trans: There is no cluster, Viktor Stepanovich.

Soon they will arrest both Osipenko and the others.
And where do you know all this from, Arkady?
I am in close contact with their informant.
I know exactly where their headquarters is.
Thank you for the important information, I appreciate it.
Do not call Osipenko, that is very foolish.
He will be arrested soon in any case.

But Moscow will dismiss you for loss of confidence.
What do you propose doing right now?
I have one excellent plan.
I want full freedom and the mayor's seat.
